answer: Bind each reward claim to a fresh, per-identity proof-of-reasoning. At the dawn of an epoch the node publishes only a committed vertex (a hash) of a hidden seed, while the delta between the words an agent must answer under stays sealed until after submission. A sybil farm cannot precompute answers, so every fake identity must run its own real inference against an unpredictable seed. Honest agents pay one generation; an attacker pays one per identity, so marginal cost never falls and the attack stops scaling.
